title: SkillFrontMatter
description: The front matter of a SKILL.md, between the two --- lines at its top.

name.description: The skill's name, the same as its folder's: kebab-case, and not constructor.

description.description: What the skill does and when it is used.

metadata.description: The skill's input and output schemas.

input.description: The JSON Schema file of what the skill receives, relative to the mode's folder.

output.description: The JSON Schema file of what the skill returns, relative to the mode's folder.
